sourceNotes: 菜单栏网速圆点支持分别自定义上传与下载颜色，并可恢复默认配色（#24）
音频输出切换器支持选择参与快捷键循环切换的设备，保留暂时断开设备的选择
检测到 Mole 时默认使用其清理引擎，保留当前会话中手动选择的引擎

en: Customize upload and download dot colors independently in the menu bar, with an option to restore the default palette (#24).
Choose which audio outputs participate in shortcut cycling, retaining selections for temporarily disconnected devices.
Use Mole as the default cleanup engine when detected, while preserving manual engine selections for the current app session.
